soundness_flags.label: ass:uniform-mixing
soundness_flags.one_line: The cited BolyCheyssonNguyen2024 theorem establishes polynomial alpha-mixing under finite polynomial kernel moments, not the displayed uniform geometric bound; derive that stronger exponential-kernel result or retag and justify it.

soundness_flags.label: ass:moment-envelope
soundness_flags.one_line: For fixed p, acyclic finite-depth Poisson branching plus the existing decay and parameter envelopes should yield a uniform eighth bin-count moment bound, so this load-bearing margin should be derived or its necessity demonstrated.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv preprint corresponding to the cited IEEE TIT article; journal version not inspected
source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 3--4, Proposition 2, Theorem 1, and Corollary 1; equations (18)--(19)
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper identifies the causal kernel as the unique solution of a Wiener--Hopf system based on the continuous correlation function, and states that first- and second-order statistics characterize stationary multivariate Hawkes processes.
The procedure uses the Fourier transform of normalized covariance and covariance density; Corollary 4 extracts exciting modes from zeros of a full spectral expression.
Theorem 2 gives the small-bin expansion F_cg(νΔt)=F_hw(ν)Δt+O(Δt^3) as Δt tends to zero; Section 3.5 proposes a spectral quadratic-form estimation method.

source_verification_receipts.version: Stochastic Processes and their Applications 126 (2016), open-access journal PDF
source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 2495--2496, description of Theorem 2; pp. 2505--2507, equations (25)--(29)
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper constructs an INAR-infinity-based family converging weakly to a Hawkes process as Δ tends to zero and presents parallel autocovariance/Yule--Walker relations plus a small-bin approximation interpretation.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv:2211.16552 preprint; cited Bayesian Analysis version not inspected
source_verification_receipts.locator: Section 3.3, Theorems 3.1--3.2 in HTML rendering; preprint pp. 12--13, Theorem 2.2
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The work proves identifiability from the full joint aggregated-count distribution under specified temporal or spatio-temporal parametric conditions, not from two covariance lags.

source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 1724, Section 4 overview; pp. 1732--1733, Theorem 3 discussion
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper derives the binned-count spectral density and proposes a strong-mixing Whittle estimator that is consistent and asymptotically normal.

source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 1 abstract and p. 2, contributions; pp. 2--3, equations (3)--(6)
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper supplies nonasymptotic confidence sets for likelihood-based network Hawkes estimates using continuous-time martingale score concentration.
Under subcriticality and a finite (1+β)-order reproduction-kernel moment, the theorem gives alpha_N(τ)=O(τ^-γ) for each 0<γ<β, not a uniform geometric alpha-mixing inequality.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace ass:uniform-mixing with a theorem derived from the acyclic common-exponential cluster representation, including constants uniform on the stated envelope; if that route fails, weaken the uniform inference claim to the polynomial mixing rate actually supported by BolyCheyssonNguyen2024.

Eliminate ass:moment-envelope by deriving it from finite-depth acyclic Poisson branching and the existing parameter/decay margins, or state a concrete parameter sequence proving that it is independently needed.

Add an explicit one-lag noninjectivity witness or a generic injectivity theorem as the first solved information-order corollary, with Koyama2025, Kirchner2016, and ZhouPapadogeorgou2025 named directly in that statement’s comparison.

recommended_next_step: Revise the fixed-margin inference assumptions—especially the unsupported geometric mixing tag—then advance the exact two-lag identification kernel to Stage 0.
